Hello, I need to report a claim. A wall fell onto my car on Ridge Lane. Can you open a case number for me? It's a gray hatchback.
This is Dr. Aidan at Astor General. I'm calling from my own phone. We have 12 trauma patients and we are running out of O-negative blood. I need the Regional Blood Bank to send units now.
I'm at Lail Apartments. They just pulled my neighbor out. She is not breathing. The rescuers need a doctor on the phone right now. Please connect us.
Hey, it's me, are you watching the news? Crazy. Anyway, I'm fine, the flat is fine. Talk soon, bye.
I'm calling for my grandmother on Mosk Lane. She uses a home oxygen machine and the power is out. The battery has maybe two hours left. We need a replacement or someone to take her in.
Hello? Hello? Please. My mother and two neighbors are inside Lail Apartments. Block C, third floor. The building came down. She is not answering her phone. Please, someone has to go there.
My grandfather is trapped under the garden wall that fell on Ridge Lane. There are two kids with him. I keep calling 112 and it drops. My battery is almost dead. Please send someone.
Hi dad, it's me. We're fine, we're all out on the street. The building is okay, just some cracks in the stairwell. Don't worry, I'll call you later tonight.
Hello, can you hear me? I'm at the hospital car park. I'm okay, I'm okay. Tell mum I'm fine, the lines are terrible, I'll try again later.
Please help, my husband has had chest pains since the shaking. He is sweating and he cannot stand up. We are on bakery street in the old town and the ambulance number does not answer.
